toolchain: g++ 13.3 (Ubuntu 24.04), -std=c++17 -O2 -g0 -frounding-math, CGAL assertions and preconditions on (no NDEBUG), GMP 6.3, MPFR 4.2
options: kernel: CGAL::Exact_predicates_exact_constructions_kernel (Epeck), not the default Epick of many CGAL examples
overlay: CGAL::Polygon_set_2 (Boolean_set_operations_2) on polygons with holes: the regularized areal overlay only

rings are rebuilt for CGAL: closing point and repeated consecutive points dropped, shells turned counter-clockwise and holes clockwise by the exact signed area (CGAL requires this orientation; it does not change the point set)

a MultiPolygon operand is the join of its polygons (Polygon_set_2::join); a polygon whose holes touch its shell or each other (OGC-valid, a CGAL precondition violation for Polygon_with_holes_2) enters as its shell minus its holes, the same point set

output polygons in OGC form, read off the result's arrangement (one polygon per face in the set, boundary walks split into simple rings at repeated vertices), not CGAL's polygons_with_holes(), whose outer boundaries may touch themselves and whose holes may touch the outer boundary at vertices; the same point set
output doubles: the double nearest to each exact rational coordinate (ties to even, subnormals included), computed by the adapter with GMP; not CGAL::to_double
--exact FILE writes the exact results (every ordinate as canonical "n/d", the exact area, the vertex count) to a side-car line per case
